authority.repository: Explicit user authorization for direct main commits. Every ref update uses expected_sha with force=false. No PRs or protection changes.
authority.onvif: Existing owned local source pins, explicit root/site and read-only native authority. No camera acquisition, publisher opening, recovery, effect reconciliation or source-value disclosure expansion.
authority.cancellation: RequestControl borrows the existing transport owner's probe. Read-only results are suppressed after observed cancellation; admitted effects/session writes retain their original owner, receipts and outcome semantics.
authority.fleet: Fleet waits and registry reviewed; no live device or network acquisition attempted.

contracts.onvif: Refuse the whole report on missing/torn histories, source changes, metadata drift, deletion, exhausted bounds or failed admission. Repeated bounded observations are not an atomic filesystem lease.
contracts.report_compatibility: Native command output schema advances to v2 because filesystem-call accounting differs from the original indexed publisher reads. Original pure projection/source handles and vendor-value opt-in remain unchanged; v1 schemas and legacy Retained APIs remain.
contracts.legacy_reads: Uncancelled successful behavior, native ledger error semantics, snapshot accounting and semantic identities are preserved. No success is delivered after cancellation observed at a completion gate.
contracts.cancellation_classification: Without a complete verified snapshot, use ERR-CLI-READ-CANCELLED-001 / EXIT-AGENT-REFUSED-005. With a complete snapshot, use outcome=cancelled, null payload, no continuation/affordances; do not reread storage to fabricate an anchor.
contracts.limits: Cooperative cancellation cannot terminate an in-progress bounded syscall. Pure query/orientation and trauma-guard derivation have phase gates. Final ONVIF metadata verification is one bounded finalization admitted before it starts; CLI delivery gates cancellation/deadline afterward.
